__comment: Task scheduler tunables (doc 16 First Dwarf Milestone, §2). Loaded by the
TaskManager autoload — no other script reads this file (Registry Pattern).
JSON = what things are (the numbers); GDScript = what things do (the loop).
NO-HANG CONTRACT (doc 16 §2.5 — these keys ARE the guarantees):
scheduler_budget_usec   - hard time budget per scheduler wake; the matching
loop stops mid-scan when exceeded and resumes from
its cursor on the next wake. Overload degrades into
assignment LATENCY, never frame time.
max_probes_per_wake     - reachability search slices per wake, whichever limit hits
first. Probes are the only non-trivial loop cost.
probe_node_cap          - A* expansions per search slice (currently 1200).
Unfinished searches resume on the next wake; only
a failed full search applies unreachable backoff.
heartbeat_interval_s    - slow safety-net poll; normal operation is
event-driven wakes (task added, dwarf idle, ...).
backoff_base_s / backoff_max_s - unreachable-task retry curve:
min(backoff_base^blocked_count, backoff_max).
unreachable_signal_threshold - consecutive blocked probes before
task_unreachable fires (doc 31: 3).
static_priorities       - per-type base priority (doc 31 table). Stored on
the task at creation; colony bonuses are computed
per wake per TYPE and never written into tasks.
Keys beginning with '__' are documentation comments and are skipped.
__comment_zone: Mining work-source settings. max_workers mirrors data/terrain/mining_config.json zone.max_workers — the zone posts this many MINE leases.
__comment_hauling: Stockpile hauling. max_haulers_per_zone: maximum concurrent HAUL leases per storage source. carry_capacity: total carry_cost points per trip, replacing the old physical-item pouch_capacity limit. Costs are authored per item in resources.json: stone/ore 1, raw timber 2, produce/furniture crates 4. Crate cost is per physical crate, regardless of quantity inside. Other items cost 1. carry_speed_mult_heavy: walking multiplier when the reserved load includes any weight_class 'heavy' item, independent of carry cost. pouch_bundle_radius: extras must be within this many blocks of the main item. pickup_time_s / deposit_time_s: handling duration at normal clock speed.
__comment_furniture: Furniture pipeline (doc 19 Phase 3). FETCH_BUILD 45 > HAUL 40: SH-verified - the placement task group's priority band TOPS restock's (0.93 vs 0.8), installing furniture outranks putting things away. build/uninstall_time_s: the work-swing duration at the ghost / installed piece.
__comment_idle: Interruptible leisure while available for work. Seconds follow simulation speed. Walks stay on clear same-level ground near the last work/spawn position; no ladders or long-distance roaming. Chairs remain separately built furniture.
